shared_tail.surface: عبد الرحمن بن جبير بن نفير

notes: «- واللفظ لأبي الطاهر -» is an editor gloss: left out
the two «ح» branches end at two different Abu Hamzas (الحمصي and بن سليم) as written: not merged; the tail from عبد الرحمن is written once after «قالا حدثنا»
«أبيه» is a relation link; the last link عوف speaks («قال سمعت النبي») and the prayer is the saying
the convergence point is the least certain part of this reading
